title: Ballade pour Georges
identity: Billaudot distinguishes Ballade pour Georges for alto saxophone and piano (GB6014) from the orchestral/string version (GB6013). The specific details found for the piano reduction came from an uploaded scan of a Lacour catalog and remain provisional until checked against the publisher edition.

evidence.claim: Billaudot’s official page identifies the orchestral/string version GB6013, not the piano reduction.

An uploaded Lacour catalog snippet indexes the 1994 alto saxophone/piano reduction, dedication to Daniel Gremelle, a 1995 first hearing, approximate 14:50 duration, and “degré supérieur”; underlying catalog provenance and edition were not authenticated.

review_focus: No review focus beyond verifying the piano-reduction version and its long-form structure until score or reliable performance evidence is available.
collection_flag: Original saxophone work, according to a derivative catalog scan; official page surfaced for a separate orchestral version.
